speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in; I see you've been treated for sinusitis and are now experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever. To understand what might be causing these new symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, frequency, or odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (complicating recent sinusitis). The combination of fever, flank pain, and persistent fatigue after an upper respiratory infection strongly suggests a urinary tract infection that has ascended to the kidneys. Given the severity of these symptoms, I am ordering a Urinalysis and Blood Culture immediately to confirm the infection and identify the causative organism for targeted antibiotic therapy.
